name: loika-v4-juvenile-patches
refs: THE SHEET TO EDIT: five poses of one dark charcoal young creature (the Loika, juvenile) on flat magenta, in a 3 by 2 grid (the sixth cell is empty magenta and stays empty). Keep it exactly; only add what is asked.

The accepted Pip marked/plain pair (project-owned): on the left the plain creature, on the right the same creature marked. Take ONLY the SHAPE and MANNER of the pale cream patches on the right one: a broad curving patch behind the shoulder bowing down the flank, and smaller oval patches over the haunch, in the soft cream of its belly, shaded by the fur. Ignore its leaf crown, its glow and its dark background entirely.
prompt: Edit the first reference. Paint pale cream PATCHES on the dark cap and back of each of the five young creatures: the same patch shapes as on the marked creature in the second reference, scaled to the young body (fewer and smaller, a broad curving patch behind the shoulder and a smaller oval patch or two over the haunch), pale cream like its belly, with the fur's soft shading and the light from the top left. Patches go only on the dark fur of the body: none on the head, face, eye rings, belly cream or toes. The sixth cell stays empty magenta. Return the SAME sheet: every creature in exactly the same position, pose, size, outline, silhouette, eyes, belly cream, toes, shadow and light (soft light from the top left) and the same flat magenta (#FF00FF) ground; no new object, no text, no labels, no borders, no glow, no leaves, no crest, no hands, no people.
